Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

The Battle of Laswari took place on November 1 , 1803 near Laswari village , Alwar . It was part of the Second Anglo-Maratha War . The British under Gerard Lake were anxious to finish the war by neutralizing the last substantial force that the Maratha confederacy possessed , consisting of twelve battalions of regular infantry trained by the adventurer Chevalier Dudrenec . Dudrenec deserted and command fell onto Ambaji Ingle , a Maratha officer . Lake decided to dispense first with his artillery and later with his infantry in a series of forced marches to catch up with these , he thus initially encountered the enemy force with just three brigades of cavalry , the British troopers by repeated charges were able to contain the Maratha army until their infantry arrived . The British , commanded by Lake were about 10,000 men strong , opposing Sindhia 's force of 9,000 veteran infantry and 5,000 cavalry under the command of Abaji . The British were also supported by allied troops from Alwar . The Maratha infantry made a most gallant defence , standing their ground until the survivors laid down their arms . The cavalry also suffered heavily . Seventy-two guns and a large quantity of ammunition and stores were captured . Lake later wrote `` I never was in so severe a business in my life or anything like it… these fellows fought like devils , or rather like heroes '' . `` The casualties on both sides were very heavy . The Company lost many officers , including Maj. Gen. Weir , Col. Vandeleur , and Maj. Griffith . Lakes 's son was also killed .
